reason: An expandable Harness session status capsule that visualizes task state, progress, timing, file changes, sub-agent activity, recent task history, and related controls.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话提供始终可见且可展开的任务状态胶囊，展示进度、耗时、文件变更、子代理活动和最近任务记录。
summaries.en: An always-visible, expandable task-status capsule for DeepSeek Harness sessions that shows progress, duration, file changes, sub-agent activity, and recent task history.

capabilities: Displays live Harness task status, progress, duration, current operations, file changes, and sub-agent summaries
Reads session projections, todo updates, tool results, and agent lifecycle events
Persists recent task history and runtime settings under the configured DSH home directory
Provides REST endpoints for settings, history, and parent-session aggregation
Can retry failed tasks through the user interface
